svg.desc: The output of vault-mirror search "why is the fruit going black underneath" -k 1, with each line labelled. One: the note, then the heading inside it: Tomatoes, Problems. Two: how close the match is: match 0.42. Three: the file and the line, so your AI can open the exact place: /Users/you/garden-notes/Garden/Tomatoes.md:13. Four: a link that opens that heading in Obsidian. Five: the paragraph itself, in full: Blossom end rot shows up as a dark patch on the base of the fruit. It comes from uneven watering, not disease.
